text: おおきな　たいかくで　そらを　とぶ。

structure.jp: おおきな　たいかくで

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows what something is done with. たいかくで = 'with its build'.

patterns.name: 〜を (path)
patterns.explanation: With verbs of moving, を shows the space that is moved through. そらを　とぶ = 'fly through the sky'.
